layout.label: Combo page: how pieces are picked
layout.help: C1: one card per piece, every colour and size on one screen (the shop's default). C2: step by step — piece 1, then piece 2, with a Next button, then a review. The price, the button and the bag are the same in both.

popularPairs.label: Popular pairs
popularPairs.help: On a set of one product ("any 2 colours"), a row of ready colour pairs: one tap sets every colour. Three to a row, so 1, 2, 3 or 6 show ("max" is the most). "learn": the pairs customers really put in their bags come first, once a pair has "minPicks" picks; the rest follow your colour order. A pair that is not made in the size already picked is greyed. A generated colour pair shows its sister pairs as links instead.

parts.label: Combo page: what shows beside the pickers
parts.help: summary: the "Set summary" box on a computer. whatsapp: "Ask about this set on WhatsApp" (only when the shop has a WhatsApp number). rules: the Size exchange · Delivery · Cash on Delivery card (each line only when that rule is on). exchangeLine: the line "Exchange one item or the whole set — the set price stays" — a promise only you can make, so it is off until you switch it on. itemPrices: the regular price of each piece in the price box (a computer).

moreSets.label: "More sets" under a combo page
moreSets.help: The other sets on sale now, as cards under the combo page: one card per ready-made set and one per auto rule and product (its colour pairs are that card's colours). "max" is how many cards.

landing.label: Sets landing page (/combos)
landing.help: The page with every set on sale: 2-piece packs, 3-piece packs and top + bottom sets, one row each. seasonTabs: the season tabs (from "Season tabs") when the rules use more than one season. perRail: the most cards in one row. Off: the page says "Coming soon".

pdpOffer.label: Matching set on the product page
pdpOffer.help: On a product that is in a set on sale, a line above the buttons: "Polo + Chino: a polo and a chino for ৳X · Save ৳Y", linking to the set. "max" is how many sets it names.
